BiblicalUsage: Mesuwrah is a measure, a portion measured out for food or drink. 1 Chronicles 23:29 puts the Levites over all manner of measure and size for the offerings, and Ezekiel 4:11 measures the prophet's water by measure, the sixth part of an hin, from time to time.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe measured bread and water are the discipline of the siege: God counts what His prophet eats, and the counting is part of the message.
